# Bundled barcode scanner

`zxing-browser.min.js`: upstream `@zxing/browser` 0.1.5 UMD build from
https://unpkg.com/@zxing/browser@0.1.5/umd/zxing-browser.min.js

SHA-256: `b5ad3df920738ca7adcb74508d7e6b6a5b9024993fb9a0c702da1ad8964eca07`

MIT license in `ZXING-LICENSE`. The bundle includes ZXing JS decoding code.
Frames and selected photos are processed locally. No camera media is uploaded.
Review upstream changes, licenses and security advisories before replacing this
file. Bump the service-worker cache version whenever any shipped asset changes.
